description: LTDS EHV Sites is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our LTDS Extra High Voltage Sites dataset comprises of all the Northern Powergrid’s EHV operational sites, The geographical map of all EHV operational locations can be accessed via the “ Network Map ” tab on our LTDS page. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Long Term Development Statement (LTDS), Extra High Voltage (EHV). The portal shows 2023-08-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
